title: D.R. Horton: Building a New Model - [Business Breakdowns, EP.154]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Horton, America’s largest homebuilder.
reader_summary.overview: Horton, America’s largest homebuilder. Our guest is Ed Wachenheim, Founder of Greenhaven Associates. Ed takes us through an incredible discussion of D.R. Horton and homebuilders broadly, including how much has changed with this business model over the years.

key_points.text: Ed shares countless entertaining stories with the management teams and backs it all up with the numbers behind this business.
It's an excellent conversation and an excellent glimpse at how someone like Ed approaches investments.
Please enjoy this breakdown of D.R.
